notes.title: Update and Maintaining Notice
notes.content: Dear Captains in Voyage Senki VR, here we inform you that our game will have a update and maintaining today, from 17:00--23:00 30th July (Beijing Time). It will fix some bugs in game after the maintaining, and we will close the rank list system temporarily. Thanks for your attention.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear users of Voyage Senki VR, thanks for all of your patience. After several weeks hard working, the new client of our game is ready! We will update it to Steam on July 13, from 14:00-16:00(Beijing time). The game server will be closed and maintained during the time.
The new client update need to clear all old data of our game as it has many new systems added in the client. The new client will be updated automatically after the maintaining when users start the former client.

Update Contents
1、Cross-platform in VR, PC and mobile. The Voyage Senki VR users on the Steam will be able to connect to users of PC and mobile clients in China. The users from different devices will be able to play together in a server.
2、Add Ranking system in game. Player can check the rank of yourself and other players.
3、Add ship building and upgrading system. Player can select and upgrade the selected ship in game.
4、Add Chatting system in VR(testing model). VR users can see the online users and the message in the world channel in game. But VR users still can’t to chat with other users now.
5、Add self-aiming function in battle. The attack will be lock to the nearest enemy ship or construction.
6、Optimized ship skill CD display. Move into the headset and can draw with the right controller.
7、Optimized MOBA view setting. Ships will not show if it is out of the view.
8、Gold self collecting function. The dropped gold will be collected into your ship automatically, if it is in range 400.
9、Optimized the tutorial system and add loading picture in game starting.
10、Self-checking for the server connecting. System will connect to the server with better condition for users.
11、Add magic book video and two new icon in game.
12、Fix bugs.

notes.title: Game Update 更新公告
notes.content:
Our third update is from 10:30--12:00 8th May(Beijing Time)
Version 1.0.3 Update 
1, UI display and game graphics improvement
2, Tutorial adjustment: move tutorial to the captain cabin, add Skip button, change steps of tutorial, add lots of animals in island for hunting.
3, UI adjustment
4, Open ship building system
5, improve special effect and transfer light marks
6, improve function choice setting, add light marks to help users choose function
7, Fix bugs on magic books 

本次更新时间定于北京时间5月8日10:30-12:00
1. 修改了显示效果，画面与UI更清晰。
2. 新手岛屿加了大量的动物，可以被炮弹击中。
3. 将新手入场的地图改为了船长室，船长室就像个主界面，链接各个地图与功能。
4. 新手帮助顺序进行了调整。
5. 制作了教学关卡可以跳过的功能。
6. 将对战按钮改为网络对战。
7. 添加建造船只的功能。
8. 添加数据埋点。
9. 修改了错别字与翻译不当的词语。
10. 引导特效的效果有点太急促了，调整的缓慢一些，让人更加的舒缓。
11. 更传送门、开箱子，对战等功能，全部添加射线，可以原地不动选到各种功能。
12. 魔法书标签页添加说明，手柄划过时会有显示。
13. 修改标签页有时候失灵的情况。
14. 传送光标靠近玩家时缩小。

notes.title: Game Update 更新公告
notes.content:
Dear Captains

The second update of Voyage Senki VR is ready. We will update game at 21:45 April 28 (Beijing time) and it may taka about 15 mins. Thanks for your attention.

Update contents

1, add two new monsters in tutorial
2, arrow speed adjustment of archers’ in island attack and defence
3, fix bugs in tutorial map
4, improve UI of ship steering
5, add HP and crystal energy display on right controller
6, add enemy ship sign in MOBA
7, optimize details in tutorial map
8, optimize display in sea battle
9, optimize starting setting, decrease starting time
10, optimize notice setting in MOBA.

亲爱的船长们，我们将在北京时间4月28日晚上21：45 对游戏进行第二次更新。

内容包括：

1.新手地图添加两个海怪和一个九头蛇怪物。
2.岛屿站弓箭手的弓箭速度调整。
3.优化新手地图引导提示。
4.修复新手引导bugs。
5.MOBA战斗增加敌方船只标识。
6.玩家右手添加船只血条和水晶能量条
7.优化新手帮助点击特效及细节添加，包括植被，植物等以及利维坦(大鱼)位置调整
8.船只被击沉后立马关闭锁定特效，高亮等。
9.一定程度优化启动时间
10.修正复活水晶能量值在Moba初期不正确。
11.修正游戏设置在运行初期未被设置。
12.优化MOBA战斗中的击杀提示。

notes.title: 更新公告 Game Update
notes.content:

1、更新新手教程内容：添加九头龙任务，添加左、右开炮教程，利维坦形象展示。

欢迎各位船长更新后来我们社区讨论拍砖！

Dear Captains in Voyage Senki VR, we are very glad to inform you that our first update is coming.

Our first update is from 13:00--13:30 24th April (Beijing Time)

Contents:
1, Tutorial add nine-heads dragon mission, add fire to left/right instruction, Leviathan show
2, Add a new ship with fire skill
3, Fix some bugs
4, Increase Fps and set continuously PING return in this version

The update version code is version 1.0.1

We are looking forward our captains throw posts on our game discussions

notes.title: Dev Weekly Blog (April 21)
notes.content:
First of all, we’d like to thanks all our players for trying our game.

    As this is our first VR game, we still have a lot of things to learn. And from the feedback we realized the first version of our game is far from the expectation of our users. Here we apologize sincerely to our users for some immature ideas in game.

    We are working on our first update according to the problems occurred this week.

1.We’ve made a version which is return PING continuously so that we can arrange our servers better for global users 

2.Optimize our tutorial map and increase Fps. That should be help for users to solve the problem with internet connecting and PC setting.

3.Redesign our tutorial. Add more clear word tips, rearrange the steps, and add some new elements in it.

  What’s new?
* Add nine-heads dragon. Mission: find and kill.
* Add a new ship with more power and fire skill.
* Add full skills on skill slots to solve no ammo fire when choose empty skill slot
* Add snake-shape monster for new tutorial of fire to left and right.
* Add a show of Leviathan in tutorial. It will be appear in game in the future.
* Fix some bugs of tutorial map. Remove some rocks may stuck ships.
* Keep on optimizing sounds effect, music and voice 
* Keep on optimizing graphics art of costume for heroes and troops 

    Right now, we are testing the above contents in tutorial, and will update it to Steam when ready. It won’t be long to wait. Many thanks for all of you. 
And welcome to leave your post on our game.


Special thanks to Twiejk, our lovely player. Thanks for you to make the fantastic video of our game, and it bring us a lot of fun to making joke with our voice provider. He is a lovely marketing and customer service man of our team and a volunteer to make it for our game as we don’t have budget for professional voice producer. You guys really bring us a lot of happy time in hard work! THE MAP. THE MAP :)))))
